Every instrument panel on the site (synths, organs, electric pianos, drum machines, sequencers, guitars, basses, pedals, amps, microphones, drums, world instruments) has a **Presets** menu in its bar. Each preset you save there is listed here, grouped by family, with the settings it holds. **Open** takes you to the instrument. With the panel keys on, 1–9 load a panel's first nine presets and Shift + 1–9 save into them.

Presets are kept **in this browser**. To keep them safe or move them to another computer, use **Export all presets** and then **Import** on the other machine. Importing adds to what is there; a preset with the same name on the same instrument is replaced.
